components.name: Plated Housing
components.notes: Resolved: reframed from a static +HP grant to a directional damage-soak. Needs a per-component "facing" attribute in the shape editor (which edge the arrow is on) plus adjacency-check logic in Loadout Test to actually enforce — not yet supported by the tool. First of the new adjacent/pointing/row-or-column family of component-interaction mechanics.

cards.name: Plated Housing
cards.effect_text: Has a direction (a yellow arrow on one edge of its shape). Give the HP of this reactor to the component its facing.

components.name: Redirect Spike
components.notes: Formerly Reinforced Spar. HP set to 35.

cards.name: Redirect Spike
cards.effect_text: Whenever another component on this mech would take damage, redirect that damage to this component instead.

cards.name: Nano Bots
cards.effect_text: Heals a small flat amount to the lowest-HP component on this mech at turn start.

components.name: Redundant Wiring
components.notes: Resolved: Redundant Wiring is destroyed the moment it triggers, so it saves one component once and is gone.

cards.name: Redundant Wiring
cards.effect_text: The first time a component on this mech would be destroyed, it is left at 1 HP instead — then Redundant Wiring itself is destroyed.

components.name: Coolant Flush
components.notes: Formerly Cryo Bleed. Resolved: targets via facing/pointing (same family as Plated Housing), not a random hardpoint. The status entry below still uses "self" as a placeholder — needs a "pointed target" status-target option once the facing mechanic is built.

cards.name: Coolant Flush
cards.effect_text: At the start of combat, applies Coolant to whatever component it points at (its facing arrow) — not this component itself.

cards.name: Insulated Core

cards.name: Capacitor Bank

cards.name: Reactive Plating
